Actions have semantic roles and changing status is announced.

Unknown outcome freezes payment; reconciliation is rendered only from backend READ permission and uses lookup/reconcile APIs without repeating payment.
cases.gap: The UI assigns allowed_actions:[READ] locally when checkout becomes uncertain, so the claimed backend-owned READ permission is not demonstrated. Define and enforce the authoritative recovery-action contract rather than inferring permission from local state.

cases.invariant: The first product intent obtains fresh workstation/device readiness and a server-owned session before the atomic sale open; failures block the sale.
cases.gap: Baseline decision remains unresolved: the invariant requires atomic Fiscal sale open on first product, while the accepted source-first implementation creates a source order and defers root preparation to payment. Reconcile the approved design/compliance baseline before closing this case.

cases.invariant: Web BLE is capability-gated and initiated by an explicit user action.
MiniPOS uses public APIs with personal OIDC authority and submits one aggregate fiscal finalize command with one durable client operation id.
The product editor preserves optional barcode and scanner/keyboard submit resolves an exact barcode before adding the item to an open shift.
The UI treats a shift as closed only when MiniPOS returns a final Fiscal Z operation and fiscal reference; missing evidence fails closed.

Production sales resolve exactly one active employee from a personal email OTP session; static tokens and free employee selection cannot start a shift, and logout is durably submitted before credentials are discarded.

The touch UI keeps the canonical original receipt reference distinct from storno evidence, renders reversal only from server-owned REVERSE permission, submits a documented reason through the MiniPOS public API and never presents an ambiguous result as success.
The touch UI validates a positive partial cash amount, derives the exact EUR card remainder, preserves CASH then CARD order and submits the ordered payment array in one aggregate finalize command.
The thin UI consumes the Fiscal operation result: UNKNOWN freezes and reconciles, FAILED is final rejection, and authoritative sale state is reloaded after every accepted payment.
cases.gap: Current checkout maps every non-FISCALIZED result, including known FAILED, to UNKNOWN and clears success journal without authoritative source operation/order reload. Preserve final rejection semantics and obtain source-owned outcome before journal cleanup.

cases.invariant: An expired, failed, logged-out or configuration-invalidated BLE session loses READY immediately, cancels local authority, attempts public-API revoke while credentials remain available and permits explicit re-issuance with a new client key.
Every MiniPOS and Fiscal public-API call has a bounded abort deadline, so a hung route cannot retain the touch UI busy state indefinitely.

cases.invariant: The cashier email session schedules rotating refresh before expiry; absent or failed refresh clears persisted personal credentials and returns the UI to login fail closed.

Email session expiry or either public API returning 401 clears cashier authority, drops local BLE READY immediately and attempts revocation with the previous in-memory bearer before returning to personal login.

After restart or re-authentication MiniPOS restores the active employee/register shift and only its server-owned DRAFT/OPEN source order; an existing durable checkout remains in reconciliation and authority loss clears its projection.

A recovered blocked Z shift disables sales and exposes reconciliation only from server-owned actions; the UI calls the dedicated reconciliation route rather than repeating shift close or reporting success without final Z evidence.

A production cashier neither downloads the employee directory nor sees object/report editors; supervisor/admin roles explicitly unlock management, and authority loss closes any previously visible administrative surface.
cases.gap: Missing configuration sets admin=true regardless of production cashier role, while the Admin render and management callbacks lack canManage guards. Hiding the ordinary header menu alone does not prove that a cashier cannot see or invoke editors.

cases.invariant: The commercial report always supplies the required ordered RFC3339 period and renders the exact EUR gross returned by the public API.
MiniPOS rejects blank or alias register/device identifiers before shift, BLE, readiness or configuration calls; every public Fiscal resource identity is a canonical UUID.

Cloud checkout resolves the bound end device from the configured register through the public Fiscal API and fails closed for mismatched, inactive, unbound or malformed registry state; deployment does not require a hidden device ID.

cases.invariant: Production administration requires a personal email OTP session, ignores public static bearer tokens, makes no pre-login API request and provides explicit logout.
The administrator refreshes rotating email-session authority before expiry; missing or failed refresh clears local authority and returns all public API access to fail-closed login state.
OIDC expiry or a Fiscal 401 clears administrator authority and returns every public API operation to the fail-closed personal login state.

Production navigation and commands derive from fail-closed OIDC roles: only ADMIN sees editors, ADMIN/AUDITOR read the audit journal, AUDITOR has report read-only access, and report execution or reconciliation requires SUPERVISOR or ADMIN in addition to server-owned allowed actions.

BeeFiscal exposes role-gated provisioning, redacted diagnostics/capabilities, REST-issued proof-of-possession BLE session preparation, separate transport/final-device metrics and distinct fiscal-device versus optional-terminal configuration through public contracts.
cases.gap: Provisioning delivery and metrics moved to extracted modules, but a manually entered X25519 public-key string plus REST session issuance is not proof of possession or an authenticated BLE session. Device response authentication and operational session protocol remain open.

cases.invariant: ADMIN and AUDITOR can filter and inspect the immutable public-API audit journal by period, actor, action, UNP and object with timestamp and hash evidence.
An absent register means an unfiltered collection read, while every supplied collection filter, report, BLE, probe, binding or resource path is UUID-validated before request construction.
Displayed paginated collections traverse all opaque cursor pages with bounded, fail-closed loop protection.
Both applications have release-gated Web, Android and iOS bundle paths; MiniPOS also fails if the noble package-exports fallback returns.
